note: Roster is data. Adding an agent is an edit HERE, never in the page markup. An entry with no sheet renders a labelled placeholder - degraded, not broken.
_background: Sampled from the sheets, so the padding around each room cell disappears against the stage. Resample if the art is regenerated.
_states: CADENCE CARRIES THE STATE. Across six rooms you read rate-of-motion before you read what a character is doing, so the tempo difference between working and idle IS the signal - not the poses.
working: the full action loop, brisk. idle: calm frames, ~5x slower - present and breathing, visibly not working.

blocked / asleep / offline: ONE frame, no motion. A stuck agent that keeps hammering tells the viewer it is working, and the floor is a bigger visual surface than the table - it would win. A frozen frame is the only honest render of stopped work.
A one-entry `frames` array IS the frozen case - it needs no special handling, and `ms` is ignored for it.
Repeating a frame in an array weights it: pip's idle sits on the open-eyed frame three beats, then blinks.

asleep and offline must never look alike. asleep is a warm dim (deliberately off); offline is desaturated (we cannot see). offline is a FEED condition layered over a state, not evidence the agent is sleeping.
_geometry: Each sheet is 1536x1024: a 3x2 grid of exact 512px cells. The title banner overlaps the TOP row only, which pushes its rooms 24-36px lower than the bottom row's. rowTop/frameH crop both rows to a common content bottom so the floor does not jump when the loop crosses from frame 2 to frame 3. Measured, not guessed - see _geometry.json.

working._: hold, raise, top of swing, STRIKE (sparks), recover

blocked._: hammer frozen at the top of the swing - work arrested mid-motion

working._: lift the piece, raise to the lamp, inspect, bring down

blocked._: still holding it up, still not satisfied

working._: read the brief, reach, place the weight, watch it tilt, consider

blocked._: wing to beak - cannot call it

working._: consult, point, trace the route, write it down, read back

blocked._: hands off the map, standing over it

working._: reach, take the slip, read it, file it into the tray, release

blocked._: holding a slip with nowhere to route it

working._: reading. Pip's lane is QUIET - still the slowest working tempo on the floor, but it must stay clearly faster than her own idle

idle._: three beats still, then a blink - about one every 7s, which is roughly a real blink rate

asleep._: the ONLY genuine asleep pose in the set - eyes closed, content. Everyone else's asleep is a dimmed rest frame.
